name: Itsuki Memory
description: Long-term memory that joins the agent turn: bounded recall before the model, exactly-once capture after a settled turn. Runs alongside OpenClaw's built-in memory rather than replacing it.

apiKey.description: Itsuki project key (itsuki_live_...). Prefer the ITSUKI_API_KEY environment variable; this field exists for operators who manage secrets through OpenClaw config.

baseUrl.description: Itsuki origin. HTTPS is required except for explicit loopback development.

userId.description: Optional sub-tenant. Narrows this plugin to one end user's memory space under your key; it can never widen scope.

tenancy.description: owner: every channel writes to the key's own memory space. per-sender: each channel-scoped sender gets an isolated sub-tenant derived from channel+sender, so one person's memory is never read by another. per-sender means the operator is storing per-person memory — tell your users.
